title: Pakistan and Turkey Deploy Forces to Saudi Arabia Under Mecca Pact
detail: At an emergency meeting in Riyadh under the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey issued a joint statement calling for practical implementation of collective-defence commitments and "rapid deployment in the Kingdom", citing recent attacks on Saudi Arabia including those targeting Mecca and Medina. Al Jazeera reports the pact is in force for the first time since August. The statement did not specify troop roles; Pakistan's defence minister said Pakistani and Turkish forces have a supporting, non-combat presence, including reconnaissance, while only Saudi troops are in combat.

media.caption: Pakistan and Turkiye join Saudi deterrence against Houthis
